versions.changelog:
Initial release of SAP Integration Skill.

- Provides integration, data extraction, and automation for SAP ABAP, HANA, and S/4HANA environments.
- Supports RFC/BAPI calls, SAP API integration, ABAP code generation, table analysis, workflow automation, and S/4HANA migration tasks.
- Includes prebuilt scripts for data extraction, RFC calls, report generation, and table analysis.
- Enforces robust authentication and security best practices for all SAP connections.
- Supports a wide range of SAP products, including ECC, S/4HANA, BW/4HANA, Ariba, SuccessFactors, and Concur.
